sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: We respect your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your choices.

sections.heading: Data We Collect
sections.body: We may collect account details (email, name), organization and project metadata, usage analytics, and technical diagnostics to improve reliability and performance.

sections.heading: How We Use Data
sections.body: To provide authentication, manage tenants and organizations, generate dynamic GraphQL schemas, run health checks, and enhance platform security and performance.

sections.heading: Cookies & Local Storage
sections.body: We may use cookies or local storage to maintain sessions, preferences, and UI state in the Dashboard.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: Security is built into the platform: JWT-based auth, request-scoped tenant isolation, hashed passwords, and optional HashiCorp Vault for secrets management.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We retain data only for as long as necessary to provide the service and to meet legal obligations.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: Optional integrations such as Cloudflare DNS may process subdomain configuration data when enabled.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You can request access, export, or deletion of your data, subject to authentication and legal requirements.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For privacy inquiries, reach out via the contact details in the README (License Email and Website).

sections.heading: Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By using MasterFabric, you agree to these terms and any referenced policies.

sections.heading: Accounts & Organizations
sections.body: You are responsible for maintaining account security. Organization owners manage access for their tenants and users.

sections.heading: Acceptable Use
sections.body: Do not misuse the service, disrupt systems, probe unauthorized data, or violate applicable laws.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: MasterFabric is licensed under AGPL-3.0 with additional terms. See LICENSE in the repository for details.

sections.heading: No Warranties
sections.body: The service is provided "as is" and "as available". We disclaim implied warranties to the fullest extent permitted by law.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the maximum extent permitted, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.

sections.heading: Changes to Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms. Continued use after updates constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: Terms are governed by applicable laws in your jurisdiction unless otherwise required.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: See README for License Email and Company Website for official communications.

sections.heading: Documentation
sections.body: See the docs directory for Setup, Architecture, Testing, System Settings, and GraphQL Schema. Start at docs/README.md.

sections.heading: Health & Status
sections.body: Health endpoints: /health on each service. GraphQL health queries available via API Gateway. The Dashboard includes a real-time health indicator and detailed status view.

sections.heading: Tech Stack
sections.body: NestJS, Next.js 15, TypeScript, PostgreSQL 15, Prisma, Redis 7, GraphQL, Docker Compose, optional Vault.
